title: Of lane
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：of　|　正文 349 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 of 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the planner kept the plan ① of the winter of that year at the square, and everybody in the district said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning: the plan had been left ② of the far end of the lane, and nobody had asked a single question. The planner had come to the district two years earlier and spoke little of the district he had left behind him.

The report for March 1943 puts it plainer. It was done ③ of necessity, and the citizen who kept the plan had measured it ④ of the hand of my mother twice before the winter came; nothing in the district was ever done of necessity in those days. The citizen wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every year thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ of the want of money, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ of the good of the village; he was not a man who explained himself, and the district had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1956 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the report. What the line asked for was that the plan be measured ⑦ of the wood of the old door, and that the names be written ⑧ of the pages of the book. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried of the wood of the old door.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1959 she kept the plan ⑨ of the winter of that year again when nobody else would, and ⑩ of the far end of the lane, she said in 1961, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the plan in the same square for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the district never forgot what had been done of the far end of the lane.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. …的（表时间：of the winter of that year）
B. prep. …的（表处所：of the far end of the lane）
C. prep. 由…构成（表方式／状态：of necessity）
D. prep. 由…构成（引出施动者或相关的人：be measured of the hand of my mother）
E. prep. …的（表原因：of the want of money）
F. prep. 由…构成（表对象／目的：of the good of the village）
G. prep. …的（表工具／材料：of the wood of the old door）
H. prep. 由…构成（表载体／处所：written of the pages of the book）

items.q: of the winter of that year
of the far end of the lane
of the hand of my mother
of the good of the village
of the wood of the old door
of the pages of the book
of the winter of that year again
of the far end of the lane, she said

answers.why: of 意为“…的”，此处引出时间 the winter of that year（那年冬天），说明那件薄薄的图纸是在何时留下的。
of 意为“…的”，此处引出处所 the far end of the lane（巷子的尽头），说明东西被放在何处。
of 意为“由…构成”，此处引出方式或状态 necessity（出于必要），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
of 意为“由…构成”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 我母亲的手：be measured of the hand of my mother。
of 意为“…的”，此处引出原因 the want of money（由于缺钱），说明整件事由何而起。
of 意为“由…构成”，此处引出对象或目的 the good of the village（全村的好处）。
of 意为“…的”，此处引出工具或材料 the wood of the old door（旧门的木料）。
of 意为“由…构成”，此处引出载体 the pages of the book（那些书页）：names written of the pages of the book。
of 意为“…的”，1959 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件薄薄的图纸，此处仍引出时间 the winter of that year。
of 意为“…的”，母亲 1961 年那句话引出的仍是那一处巷子的尽头。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1949 年那年冬天前后，规划员把那件薄薄的图纸留在了广场。（of the winter of that year）
那件薄薄的图纸被放在巷子的尽头，谁也没有过问。（of the far end of the lane）
整件事是出于必要做成的，规划报告上写得明白。（of necessity）
入冬之前，那件薄薄的图纸已经由我母亲的手丈量过两回。（be measured of the hand of my mother）
叔叔说，整件事是由由于缺钱起的。（of the want of money）
他说，家里从来没有人为全村的好处做过这件事。（of the good of the village）
answers: In 1949 the planner kept the plan of the winter of that year at the square.
The plan had been left of the far end of the lane, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done of necessity, or so the report says.
The plan had been measured of the hand of my mother twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun of the want of money.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it of the good of the village.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 of 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1949 the planner kept the plan of the winter of that year, and nobody forgot it.
The plan had been left of the far end of the lane for three years.
The work was done of necessity, as it always was in those days.
The plan had been measured of the hand of my mother twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the plan of the winter of that year again when nobody else would.
The whole district never forgot what had been done of the far end of the lane.
